column1: # Covers: chaebol groups and affiliates, electronics and tech, cars and car models, internet services and apps,
# games and game studios, entertainment agencies, broadcasters and newspapers, banks, card companies, insurers,
# securities firms, retail and convenience stores, food, drink, beer and soju, snacks and ramyun, K-beauty and
# cosmetics, fashion, airlines, shipping and logistics, pharma and bio, construction and apartment brands,
# telecom, sports clubs (K League, KBO, KBL, V-League), cafe and restaurant franchises.
